```{r variant_filtering_prep}
#| eval: true
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

filt_html <- pcgrr:::filtering_summary(pcg_report)
fmt_n_html <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)

## actionable variants removed by filtering - shown as warnings
filt_warn_html <- function(d, title, intro) {
  if (NROW(d) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n## ", title, "\n\n", intro, "\n\n",
      paste0("* ", pcgrr:::filtered_variant_labels(d), collapse = "\n"),
      "\n\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}
filt_warn_html(
  filt_html$read_support_removed,
  "Actionable variants removed by depth/allelic support filtering",
  paste0("The following actionable variants (Tier 1/2) or mutation hotspots ",
         "did not pass the depth/allelic support thresholds and are not ",
         "considered in this report - review them and/or the filtering ",
         "settings:"))
filt_warn_html(
  filt_html$germline_removed,
  "Actionable variants filtered as likely germline",
  paste0("The following actionable variants (Tier 1/2) were filtered as ",
         "likely germline events and are not considered in this report - ",
         "germline status should be verified (e.g. with a matched control ",
         "sample):"))

## overview and depth/allelic support filtering (all assay modes)
cat("::: {.callout-note title=\"Variant filtering - SNVs/InDels\" collapse=\"true\"}\n\n")
if (!is.na(filt_html$n_input)) {
  cat("Of __n = ", fmt_n_html(filt_html$n_input), "__ somatic SNVs/InDels ",
      "in the input VCF, __n = ", fmt_n_html(filt_html$n_reported), "__ ",
      "were retained after filtering and are considered in this report",
      if (filt_html$tumor_only) paste0(
        " (depth/allelic support filtering, then germline filtering of the ",
        "tumor-only input)"), ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat("**Depth and allelic support**\n\n")
if (NROW(filt_html$read_support) == 0) {
  cat("No thresholds for sequencing depth or allelic support were set - no ",
      "variants were filtered on depth/allelic support.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  rs <- filt_html$read_support
  cat("Variants were filtered on sequencing depth (DP), allelic fraction ",
      "(AF) and allelic depth (AD) in the tumor",
      if (!filt_html$tumor_only) " and control", " sample",
      if (!filt_html$tumor_only) "s", ", in the order listed:\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("| Step | Threshold | Removed | Remaining |\n",
      "|:-----|:----------|--------:|----------:|\n",
      paste0("| ", rs$STEP, " | ",
             pcgrr:::fmt_threshold_filtering(rs$THRESHOLD), " | ",
             ifelse(as.logical(rs$APPLIED), fmt_n_html(rs$N_REMOVED),
                    paste0("_", rs$NOTE, "_")), " | __",
             fmt_n_html(rs$N_REMAINING), "__ |", collapse = "\n"),
      "\n\n", sep = "")
}

## tumor-only germline filtering
if (filt_html$tumor_only) {
  cat("**Germline filtering (tumor-only)**\n\n")
  cat("Without a matched control sample, likely germline variants are ",
      "excluded from the tumor-only input based on the following settings:",
      "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(pcgrr:::tumor_only_settings_markdown(filt_html$tumor_only_settings),
      "\n")
  share_md <- function(d) {
    desc <- pcgrr:::germline_filter_descriptions(
      filt_html$tumor_only_settings)
    lbl <- ifelse(d$CLASSIFICATION %in% names(desc),
                  desc[d$CLASSIFICATION], d$CLASSIFICATION)
    keep <- d$CLASSIFICATION %in% pcgrr:::retained_filter_classes()
    bar <- paste0(
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:120px;height:0.7em;",
      "background:#e4e4e4;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:middle;",
      "margin-right:6px'><span style='display:block;height:100%;width:",
      round(100 * d$SHARE, 1), "%;background:",
      ifelse(keep, report_color, "#9e9e9e"), ";border-radius:2px'></span>",
      "</span>", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * d$SHARE), "%")
    cat("| Classification | Filter | Variants | Share |\n",
        "|:---------------|:-------|---------:|:------|\n",
        paste0("| ", ifelse(keep, paste0("__", lbl, "__"), lbl), " | ",
               ifelse(keep, "", paste0("`", d$CLASSIFICATION, "`")), " | ",
               fmt_n_html(d$N), " | ", bar, " |",
               collapse = "\n"),
        "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (NROW(filt_html$germline) > 0) {
    cat("_Step 1 - germline filters_: classification of the variants (n = ",
        fmt_n_html(sum(filt_html$germline$N)), ") - variants matching more ",
        "than one germline filter are counted as _MULTIPLE FILTERS_:\n\n",
        sep = "")
    share_md(filt_html$germline)
  }
  if (NROW(filt_html$exonic) > 0) {
    cat("_Step 2 - exonic status_: classification of the remaining somatic ",
        "variants (n = ", fmt_n_html(sum(filt_html$exonic$N)), ") - ",
        "non-exonic variants are excluded:\n\n", sep = "")
    share_md(filt_html$exonic)
  }
}
cat(":::\n\n")
```
